name: @natlang/pi
description: pi's coding agent as a natlang program: the agent (pi.nl) on a big model calls pi's tools, natural-language functions on a small model that gate commands, digest output, review edits, watch progress and check answers. agent.ts is the optimized harness: the same judgments around a TypeScript loop.

pi.description: natlang run applications/pi -- [-p] [--fast] TASK... | eval [NAME...] [--variants pure,plain,system-one,codemode,route]
